New Delhi private city tour

Old Delhi · New Delhi · 1 day

1 day New Delhi tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Mughal Delhi in the morning, colonial and modern Delhi in the afternoon, with a rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk in between.

At a glance

Duration
About 8 hours
Starts
9 am
Transport
Private AC car
Tour type
Private
Guide
Licensed, English speaking
Pickup

What makes this one worth it

  • Jama Masjid and the view from its steps
  • A cycle-rickshaw through Chandni Chowk and the spice market
  • Humayun's Tomb, Qutub Minar and the Lotus Temple
  • Photo stops at India Gate and Parliament House

Your tour schedule

  1. 9:00 AM

    Pickup and into Old Delhi

    Your driver and guide collect you from your hotel or chosen address in Delhi, Noida or Gurgaon.

  2. Morning

    Jama Masjid

    One of India's largest mosques, built under Shah Jahan between 1650 and 1656. A pause on the steps for the view over the old city.

  3. Morning

    Chandni Chowk by rickshaw

    A cycle-rickshaw through the 17th-century lanes of Chandni Chowk.

  4. Late morning

    Spice market and the Red Fort

    A walk through the Khari Baoli spice market and a look at the Red Fort walls from outside.

  5. Midday

    Lunch break

    Lunch at a restaurant your guide recommends.

  6. Afternoon

    Humayun's Tomb and Qutub Minar

    Humayun's Tomb, the UNESCO-listed garden tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal, then the 12th-century Qutub Minar, over 70 metres tall.

  7. Late afternoon

    Lotus Temple, India Gate and Parliament

    The white marble Lotus Temple, then photo stops at India Gate and Parliament House before drop-off at your hotel.

Questions people ask

Is this a private or shared Delhi city tour?
It is completely private: just you and your own group, travelling in an AC car with your own driver and a licensed English-speaking guide. No other travellers are added to your car or your plan for the day.
What time does the tour start and end?
We usually collect you from your hotel or the airport in Delhi NCR at about 9:00 AM, and the tour runs for around 8 hours. When you get back depends on traffic and how long you choose to spend at each stop. Please note the Red Fort is closed on Mondays, so on that day we only see it from outside.
Are monument entrance tickets included?
Yes. All monument tickets are included in the price, and your guide handles them at each gate so you skip the ticket queue.
Are food and drinks included?
Meals are not part of the tour, but we keep bottled water in the car for you. Your guide is happy to suggest clean, well-loved places to eat in Old and New Delhi, so lunch is easy to sort out.
Is the Chandni Chowk rickshaw ride safe and included?
Yes, the cycle-rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk is included and is one of the highlights of the day. The riders know these lanes well, and your guide stays close to you the whole time.
Is this tour suitable for families and senior travellers?
Yes. We keep the pace easy and the walking short, and your guide can add rest stops or change the order of sights for children, older travellers or anyone who needs extra breaks.
Do I need a visa?
Most foreign visitors, including those from the US, UK, Canada, UAE and Mexico, need a valid Indian visa or e-Visa before they travel. Please check the latest rules on the official Indian government visa website before you book flights.
